title: UI: Add delta time (displayed) to default columns
description:
An often manually added column to the packet list is the delta time.
Add "Delta" to the default profile, as the option of least
surprise. Update the documentation.

https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Principle_of_least_astonishment  
  
`"Delta time",  "%Gt",`  
  
You are adding `Delta time displayed` but using the title for `Delta time captured`
```
C:\>tshark -G column-formats | findstr /I delta
%Tt     Delta time                              _ws.col.delta_time
%Gt     Delta time displayed
```

Perhaps, although 1) I try to keep the column small, so use a short title, and 2) most people will likely understand what they see, unlike when showing Delta time captured.

But what do others think. @SYN-bit, @AndersBroman ?
I've used "Δ" instead of "delta" in column titles in the past to conserve space. I'm not sure if that would be universally recognizable, though.

No strong opinion, maybe a bit reluctant to add yet another default column.
But with modern screens horisontal space might not be a problem.
Just my 2 cents.
Best regards
Anders

skrev:
@AndersBroman : I'm reluctant too. This is one of those that is advised/requested by many people. So it makes sense to do it now in development and see how that goes.
No objection here.

The description is clear now - thanks!  
5.0 is a milestone. What about returning to what the field was originally (#491)?  
If people care more about the displayed times then make it so and rename the other to Delta Time Captured.

I find this header hard to read. The Δtime is not a word my brain recognizes and (disp.) I have to think to know what is. And only two letters from displayed.

I suggest just «Delta Time».

All column titles in our default profile are one word, I'd like to keep it that way, as the column title also defines the minimum width when auto-resizing column widths. Just a simple "Delta" is what I use for my delta time displayed columns.

I'm not a fan of the "Δtime (displ.)" column name in the current commit. We don't use the full names like "Frame Number" or "Source address", so why would we need to be such specific for this new column.

IMHO the name of the column in descending order of preference would be:

* Delta
* Delta Time
* Δ
Okay, after looking around for a while, I simplified the column title to "Delta", with "Delta time displayed" as tooltip. That should be a reasonable compromise IMHO.
Perfect, thanks!
Can you add an entry under the "New and Updated Features" in the Wireshark release notes?

Under certain conditions this causes the Length column (now the same ordinal number as what the Info column used to be) to become very wide, like the Info column. I haven't tracked down what circumstances cause this (switching profiles, switching back and forth between 4.6 and 4.7/master, etc.) A user can fix the width, though.

@JaapKeuter This is a regression issue which happens when a profile uses default columns. The `recent` file is written with column lengths but the `preferences` file does not configure the columns because they are default. When switching from version 4.6 to version 4.7 the length for the Info column (usually very big) is now used for the Length column. Create a clean profile on 4.6 and then move to 4.7 to trigger this issue.
